patterns.name: Doji
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 8: "When a market opens and closes at the same level, it forms a doji line."

patterns.name: Dragonfly_Doji
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 8: Open, high, close at same level + long lower wick
patterns.detection: body < 5%, upper wick < 10%, lower wick > 70%

patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 4: Small body at upper end + long lower wick (≥2× body) Bulkowski accuracy: ~60-65%
patterns.detection: body < 35%, lower wick > 2× body, prior bar bearish

patterns.name: Inverted_Hammer
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 5: Like hammer but with long upper wick at bottom
patterns.detection: body < 35%, upper wick > 2× body, prior bar bearish

patterns.name: Hanging_Man
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 4: Hammer shape but in uptrend

patterns.name: Shooting_Star
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 5: Inverted hammer in uptrend = rejection
patterns.detection: inverted hammer shape, prior bar bullish

patterns.name: Bullish_Engulfing
patterns.theory: Nison ch. 6: "Small black candle, then large white body engulfs prior" Bulkowski accuracy: ~63%
patterns.detection: prev bear, curr bull, curr engulfs prev body, body ratio > 80%

patterns.name: Bearish_Engulfing
patterns.detection: mirror of P28

patterns.name: Piercing_Line

patterns.name: Dark_Cloud_Cover
